honest_verdict.principle: One-line continuity summary naming KV260, PolarFire, GateMate, and no-speedup status.

kv260_status.principle: KV260 is classified as reachable, unreachable, or skipped with an honest reason.

milestone.principle: Pins this receipt to milestone 2026.07.489 rather than a floating board state.

no_destructive_flash.principle: True because no flashing, programming, or destructive write command was run.

no_host_mmcblk_kv260_evidence.principle: True because KV260 evidence is SSH-only and not derived from host removable storage.

polarfire_status.principle: PolarFire is classified as reachable/workload_receipt, unreachable, or skipped with an honest reason.

polarfire_workload_hash.principle: The value is the board-local workload output hash only when that receipt validates.

preconditions_checked.principle: Records date, sanitized environment, local toolchain, USB visibility, and SSH targets before board classification.

extropic_tsu.boundary: public THRML/Extropic TSU/XTR context only; no local authenticated TSU run

logical_kona.boundary: public Logical/Kona context only; no local authenticated Kona run
